boards.school_name: California Polytechnic State University-San Luis Obispo
boards.title: Your First Weekend at California Polytechnic State University-San Luis Obispo, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A Thursday-to-Sunday introduction to Cal Poly and San Luis Obispo, balancing campus orientation, recreation, student-built landscapes, and public cultural stops.

cards.title: Begin downtown on Thursday evening
cards.subtitle: Thursday evening · Higuera Street
cards.notes: Walk the five-block market footprint, listen to the scheduled entertainment, and browse before deciding whether to buy food or produce.
cards.short_summary: Get an early look at downtown during its recurring pedestrian market.
cards.evidence_claim: Downtown SLO states that its Farmers’ Market operates every Thursday from 6–9 p.m. on five blocks of Higuera Street with vendors and entertainment.
cards.access_notes: The market runs Thursdays from 6–9 p.m.; its street boundaries close to vehicles at 5 p.m. Pets are prohibited except trained service animals.

cards.title: Find the campus gathering point
cards.subtitle: Friday morning · Building 65
cards.notes: Locate the second-floor welcome desk, refill water, charge your phone, and identify a lounge you can return to between activities.
cards.short_summary: Use the University Union as a practical first campus waypoint.
cards.evidence_claim: ASI identifies the University Union as a Cal Poly gathering place with lounges, open seating, Wi-Fi, charging and hydration stations, and a second-floor welcome desk offering campus maps.
cards.access_notes: Building 65. Consult the page’s current operating-hours panel before visiting because modified schedules may apply.

cards.title: Learn one reliable meal location
cards.subtitle: Friday midday · Campus dining complex
cards.notes: Walk through all three floors, note the allergen-free station, and choose a meeting point your group can recognize later.
cards.short_summary: Map out a central dining option before the weekend gets busy.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Poly’s self-guided tour describes Vista Grande as a three-floor dining complex with eight restaurant options, including an allergen-free station and indoor and outdoor seating.
cards.access_notes: Check the linked campus-dining schedule before going. Cal Poly states that campus dining is cash-free and accepts cards or Grubhub preorders.

cards.title: Take a quiet garden circuit
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Five-acre campus garden
cards.notes: Follow the garden paths through plantings from the world’s Mediterranean-climate regions and pause at the campus overlooks.
cards.short_summary: Slow the pace with a student-built horticultural landscape.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Poly states that the five-acre Leaning Pine Arboretum features gardens representing five Mediterranean-climate regions, welcomes visitors, and charges no admission.
cards.source_title: Leaning Pine Arboretum - Plant Sciences - Cal Poly
cards.access_notes: Open 8 a.m.–5 p.m. Monday through Saturday, except academic holidays; open year-round. Stay on established garden paths.

cards.title: Tour the Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Building 43
cards.notes: Ask at Membership Services for the no-reservation tour, then note the courts, pools, and check-in process for future visits.
cards.short_summary: See how campus recreation works before planning a workout.
cards.evidence_claim: ASI says guided Cal Poly Recreation Center tours are offered Thursday through Sunday from 1–4 p.m. without reservations and begin at Membership Services.
cards.access_notes: Guided tours are listed Thursday–Sunday, 1–4 p.m., with no reservation needed. Facility participation has separate membership and guest rules.

cards.title: Try an on-campus bowling session
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · University Union Room 118
cards.notes: Gather a small group, confirm the posted rates, and arrive before the evening rush if you prefer standard lighting to cosmic bowling.
cards.short_summary: Turn the first evening into an easy indoor group activity.
cards.evidence_claim: Mustang Lanes’ official site identifies a 10-lane public bowling alley in Cal Poly’s University Union and lists Friday and Saturday open bowling from 10 a.m.–10 p.m.
cards.source_title: Mustang Lanes | San Luis Obispo Bowling
cards.access_notes: The posted summer schedule lists Friday and Saturday hours of 10 a.m.–10 p.m.; cosmic bowling begins at 8 p.m. and is first come, first served.

cards.title: Walk to Cal Poly’s student-built structures
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · Poly Canyon
cards.notes: Wear closed-toe walking shoes, bring water, and view the documented experimental structures without climbing on or entering them.
cards.short_summary: Connect Learn by Doing with full-scale projects in the landscape.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Poly’s College of Architecture and Environmental Design describes Poly Canyon as an adjacent nine-acre outdoor experimental construction laboratory containing student-designed structures.
cards.source_title: Poly Canyon - College of Architecture & Environmental Design - Cal Poly
cards.access_notes: This is an outdoor canyon destination reached on foot. Check campus notices and weather, remain on authorized routes, and do not climb structures.

cards.title: See the Central Coast railroad collection
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday · Santa Barbara Avenue
cards.notes: Look for artifacts tied to local rail lines, then examine the operating model railroad as a geographic guide to the region.
cards.short_summary: Add local transportation history to Saturday’s downtown circuit.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum states that it preserves Central Coast railroad history, displays regional railroad artifacts, and is open Saturdays from 10 a.m.–4 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Open Saturdays from 10 a.m.–4 p.m. at 1940 Santa Barbara Avenue, just south of the San Luis Obispo Amtrak station.

cards.entity_name: San Luis Obispo Museum of Art
cards.title: Browse the current art exhibitions
cards.subtitle: Sunday late morning · Mission Plaza
cards.notes: Start with the current galleries, then step outside to compare the museum’s setting with nearby public art and the creek corridor.
cards.short_summary: Use a compact, free museum visit to anchor Sunday downtown.
cards.evidence_claim: SLOMA states that it is located at Mission Plaza, welcomes visitors of all ages, opens Thursday through Monday from 11 a.m.–5 p.m., and offers free admission.
cards.source_title: Visit - San Luis Obispo Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Open Thursday–Monday, 11 a.m.–5 p.m., subject to listed holidays and 2026 installation closures. Enter from the Mission Plaza side.

cards.entity_name: Mission San Luis Obispo de Tolosa Museum
cards.title: Close with the Mission museum
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon · Mission Plaza
cards.notes: Visit the Convento Wing collection, read the Native Californian and Mission-era interpretation, and treat the active church respectfully.
cards.short_summary: Finish the weekend with a documented layer of local history.
cards.evidence_claim: Mission San Luis Obispo states that its Convento Wing museum contains Native Californian, Mission Era, and American settlement artifacts and does not charge admission.
cards.source_title: Visit Mission San Luis Obispo de Tolosa
cards.access_notes: Museum hours are Wednesday–Sunday, 11 a.m.–4:30 p.m. The active Mission is open year-round; services may affect visitor access.
